INSERT INTO crm.leads (
  id, name, email, domain, linkedin, message,
  source, referred_by, ip_address,
  is_business_email, lead_score, email_sent,
  status, email_opened, link_clicked,
  sequence_active, created_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.name }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  '{{ $json.email_domain }}',
  '{{ $json.linkedin }}',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.referred_by }}',
  '{{ $json.ip_address }}',
  false,
  0, false, 'Newsletter', false, false, false,
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamp
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_activity = NOW();

SELECT
    '{{ $json.name }}'::text AS name,
    '{{ $json.email }}'::text AS email,
    '{{ $json.email_domain }}'::text AS email_domain,
    '{{ $json.linkedin }}'::text AS linkedin,
    '{{ $json.message }}'::text AS message,
    '{{ $json.source }}'::text AS source,
    '{{ $json.referred_by }}'::text AS referred_by,
    '{{ $json.ip_address }}'::text AS ip_address,
    '{{ $json.user_agent }}'::text AS user_agent,
    '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamp AS received_at,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM crm.leads WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'
    ) AS email_exists;

INSERT INTO crm.leads (
  id, name, email, company, domain, company_size, industry, segment,
  lead_score, email_sent, status, email_opened, link_clicked,
  assigned_to, notes, linkedin, message, source, referred_by,
  ip_address, created_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.name }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.email }}'),
  '{{ $json.company }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.email_domain }}'),
  {{ $json.company_size }},
  '{{ $json.industry }}',
  '{{ $json.segment }}',
  0, false,
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  false, false,
  CASE 
    WHEN '{{ $json.segment }}' = 'Enterprise'   THEN 'souvik@company.com'
    WHEN '{{ $json.segment }}' = 'Mid-Market'   THEN 'sales1@company.com'
    WHEN '{{ $json.segment }}' = 'SMB'          THEN 'sales2@company.com'
    ELSE 'souvik@company.com'
  END,
  '',
  '{{ $json.linkedin }}',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.referred_by }}',
  '{{ $json.ip_address }}',
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamp
) RETURNING *;

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  message      = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.message }}' != '' THEN '{{ $json.message }}' ELSE message END,
  source       = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.source }}'  != '' THEN '{{ $json.source }}'  ELSE source  END,
  referred_by  = '{{ $json.referred_by }}',
  ip_address   = '{{ $json.ip_address }}',
  linkedin     = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.linkedin }}' != '' THEN '{{ $json.linkedin }}' ELSE linkedin END,
  last_activity = NOW(),
  assigned_to  = CASE 
    WHEN assigned_to IS NULL THEN
      CASE 
        WHEN segment = 'Enterprise'   THEN 'souvik@company.com'
        WHEN segment = 'Mid-Market'   THEN 'sales1@company.com'
        WHEN segment = 'SMB'          THEN 'sales2@company.com'
        ELSE 'souvik@company.com'
      END
    ELSE assigned_to
  END
WHERE email = LOWER('{{ $json.email }}')
RETURNING id, name, email, company, segment, status, assigned_to;

parameters.query:
UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  status = 'Nurturing',
  email_sent = TRUE,
  last_activity = NOW(),
  email_sequence_stage = 1,
  last_email_sent_at = NOW(),
  next_email_scheduled = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes',
  sequence_active = TRUE
WHERE id = {{ $('Edit_Fields').item.json.id }};

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  lead_score = lead_score +
    CASE
      WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'email_opened' THEN 5
      WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'link_clicked' THEN 10
      WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'pricing_page_visited' THEN 20
      WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'demo_requested' THEN 25
      ELSE 0
    END,
  email_opened = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'email_opened' THEN TRUE
    ELSE email_opened
  END,
  link_clicked = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'link_clicked' THEN TRUE
    ELSE link_clicked
  END,
  last_activity = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
RETURNING *;

SELECT
  id, name, email, company, segment,
  lead_score, status, last_activity,
  email_opened, link_clicked
FROM crm.leads
WHERE id = {{ $('Normaliser-2').item.json.id }};

SELECT *
FROM crm.leads
WHERE sequence_active = TRUE
  AND next_email_scheduled <= NOW()
  AND email_sequence_stage < 4
  AND status != 'Hot'
  AND status != 'Contacted';

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  email_sequence_stage = {{ $('Build_Email').item.json.sendEmail }},
  last_email_sent_at   = NOW(),
  next_email_scheduled = {{ $('Build_Email').item.json.next_email_scheduled ? ("'" + $('Build_Email').item.json.next_email_scheduled + "'::timestamp") : "NULL" }},
  sequence_active      = {{ $('Build_Email').item.json.sequence_active ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  last_activity        = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Build_Email').item.json.id }}
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO crm.email_templates (segment, stage, subject, html, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.segment }}',
  {{ $json.stage }},
  '{{ $json.subject }}',
  '{{ $json.html }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (segment, stage) DO UPDATE SET
  subject    = EXCLUDED.subject,
  html       = EXCLUDED.html,
  updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO crm.leads (
  id, name, email, company, domain, company_size, industry, segment,
  linkedin, message, source, referred_by, ip_address,
  lead_score, email_sent, status, email_opened, link_clicked,
  assigned_to, notes, created_at,
  email_sequence_stage, sequence_active
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.name }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.email }}'),
  '{{ $json.company }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.domain }}'),
  {{ $json.company_size }},
  '{{ $json.industry }}',
  '{{ $json.segment }}',
  '{{ $json.linkedin }}',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.referred_by }}',
  '{{ $json.ip_address }}',
  0, false,
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  false, false, NULL, '',
  '{{ $json.created_at }}'::timestamp,
  0, false
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_activity = NOW(),
  source = CASE WHEN crm.leads.source = '' THEN EXCLUDED.source ELSE crm.leads.source END;

SELECT
  id, name, email, company, segment,
  lead_score, status, source,
  last_activity, email_opened, link_clicked,
  email_sequence_stage, sequence_active
FROM crm.leads
ORDER BY last_activity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 150;

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  email_sequence_stage = 1,
  sequence_active      = TRUE,
  next_email_scheduled = NOW(),
  status               = 'Nurturing',
  last_activity        = NOW()
WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'
RETURNING *;

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  lead_score    = lead_score + 15,
  last_activity = NOW()
WHERE email = LOWER('{{ $json.email }}')
RETURNING id, name, email, company, segment,
          lead_score, status, assigned_to;
